## Où j'en suis
The SAML ACS endpoint for Fernhill is finished: signature verification and condition checks are implemented with `signxml` (python3-saml was dropped), the old `saml_utils` now lives in `api/auth/saml/verify.py`, and lint, mypy and the full suite pass. PR #412 is merged into `main`; the only work left is the staging metadata exchange for Thursday's demo.

- [en-cours] Fernhill's staging IdP metadata is not loaded yet.
- [prochaine-étape] Load that metadata and send Fernhill our staging SP metadata by Wednesday EOD, ahead of the demo Thursday 10:00 NY; then open a separate ticket for enforcing SSO / disabling password login.
- [essai-raté] python3-saml on the Alpine image: lxml/xmlsec libxml2 version mismatch, and building lxml from source took 9 min and still failed on a missing crypto module.
- [décision] Go with signxml, remove python3-saml and xmlsec from the Dockerfile, write the condition checks ourselves and read attributes only from `signed_xml` (source: t08)
- [décision] Clock skew set to 120 s per Fernhill's contract annex; password login untouched, separate ticket (source: t12)
- [décision] No `--admin` and no `--auto` merge; the person pings Maya for review (source: t21)
